reports.title: Globant Reports 2026 Third Quarter Financial Results

lines: “In Q3 2026, Globant delivered $611.1 million in revenue, in line with the midpoint of our guidance, and expanded adjusted operating margin sequentially to 14.1%.

desk.headline: Revenue down 1% to $611m, in line with estimates; 2026 outlook narrowed toward the lower part of the prior range
results: Revenue slipped 1% to $611m, at the middle of the company's guidance.
Adjusted EPS was $1.48 versus $1.53 a year ago; IFRS EPS fell to $0.32 because of $27.4m of restructuring costs.
The adjusted operating margin improved from the prior quarter to 14.1%, though it was below 15.5% a year earlier.
The AI Pods business reached a $106.6m annual run rate, and headcount fell to 26,164 from 29,020 a year ago.
Globant bought back $25m of shares and doubled its buyback programme to $250m through December 2027.

guidance.summary: Globant narrowed its 2026 outlook to revenue of $2,429–2,437m (prior $2,428–2,462m) and adjusted EPS of $5.77–5.87 (prior $5.75–6.15), pulling down the top end. It expects Q4 revenue of $596–604m, a 1.4–2.7% fall from a year ago.

points: Middle East revenue fell 34% from a year ago, and management does not expect a recovery there in Q4.
Latin America was the fastest-growing region, up about 8%; North America was flat.
The year-end AI Pods target was raised to at least $130m, with pricing based on outcomes rather than hours.
Some large clients are slower to move to the new pricing model; travel and hospitality clients remain under pressure.
No 2027 guidance yet; the CEO said he aims to return the company to growth, with an outlook due in February.
call.source: Earnings call transcript: Globant Q3 2026 — Investing.com, 19 Nov 2026

watch: Whether Q4 revenue lands within $596–604m as the Middle East business keeps shrinking.
AI Pods reaching the $130m run-rate target by year end.
The first 2027 outlook, due with Q4 results in February.
